title: Two-level-header financial table in a native PDF
routingReason: PDF containing detected table structures with merged/multi-row headers — MarkItDown flattens these to run-on text; Docling's TableFormer reconstructs cell topology, so the router must escalate.

tokens.note: Token count may INCREASE here — fidelity beats compression for tables. Every numeric cell must match the source exactly; the two-level header (year × metric) must flatten into unambiguous column names.
